title: Get a lifetime of Youbooks AI book creation for a one-time $33 payment
content_html:
TL;DR: Get lifetime Youbooks access, research tools, and full commercial rights for a one-time $32.97 (reg. $540) through Aug. 25.

Credit: Youbooks

$49
$540 Save $491

Having enough expertise to write a book and having enough time to finish one are very different things. Youbooks narrows that gap by turning a topic, writing preferences, and supporting research into a non-fiction manuscript. Lifetime access is $32.97 instead of $540 through Aug. 25.

The platform uses multiple AI models, including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Llama, to develop and refine content.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Projects can reach 300,000 words. Users can define a tone and style, store up to 100 writing samples, and upload as many as 100 source documents. Those sources can include personal research, transcripts, and memos, helping the manuscript reflect the author’s information and voice.

Youbooks also performs real-time web searches during composition to incorporate current facts, statistics, and news. However, authors should still review and edit the finished work before publication.

The lifetime plan includes 250,000 monthly credits, with approximately one credit used per delivered word or uploaded source word. Future plan enhancements are included, and authors retain full commercial rights to publish, distribute, or sell their content.

Finished books can be downloaded as PDF, EPUB, DOCX, or Markdown files. Distribution may require additional formatting: Print-on-demand publishers commonly need a Word template exported to PDF, while ebook platforms may accept an edited EPUB.

For experts, creators, entrepreneurs, educators, coaches, and publishers with solid source material, Youbooks offers a faster route from accumulated knowledge to an editable manuscript.

Get the Youbooks AI Non-Fiction Book Generator Lifetime Subscription for just $32.97 (reg. $540) through Aug. 25.
